# Inert CPython source fixtures

This directory contains data-only CPython source fixtures. Ten files are exact regular-file members read from the CPython 3.13.12 release archive `Python-3.13.12.tar.xz`; an eleventh file retains the supporting `Modules/Setup.bootstrap.in` template. The archive size, SHA-256, member paths, sizes, and member SHA-256 values are recorded in `provenance.json`; tests repeat the per-member size and digest checks before parsing or inspecting fixture bytes.

The release archive identity recorded here is 22,926,488 bytes with SHA-256 `2a84cd31dd8d8ea8aaff75de66fc1b4b0127dd5799aa50a64ae9a313885b4593`. The `official_python_org_archive_verified: false` field means this fixture manifest does not itself contain an archive-verification receipt; it is not a claim that no separate verification was performed. The separate Feature 189 release-input audit records a retained signature-verification transcript and its trust limits at `specs/189-static-python-fixture/release-input-audit-20261021.md`. The `.source` suffix keeps upstream source bytes as inert fixture data; tests inspect them but do not import or execute them.

The top-level `files` list in `provenance.json` records five exact source fixtures from the previously reviewed Git checkout `1cbe481834751b0125e006042ffbd8cd5eaec8a8` (`v3.13.12`), including `Python/import.c.source`, which is outside the release archive-member list. The `release_archive_fixtures` section separately records the ten AST/C source members and the support template member. These origins are not interchangeable.

The upstream PSF license is retained as `LICENSE`. Copied snippets in the preparation module retain the same license. No build, generated frozen header, static ELF, runtime startup, or production admission is established by these source fixtures.
